subject.title: feat: adopt shared design system across ClawHub UI

question: Should this stacked design-system adoption wait until the design-system dependency is installable in GitHub Actions/Vercel and base PR https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/3018 is ready?
rationale: The source changes look coherent, but the private dependency and stack order are operational merge gates that automation cannot safely resolve without maintainer intent.

options.title: Wait for stack and credentials
options.body: Keep this PR open and merge it only after the base PR lands or is merged in order, the design-system dependency is accessible to CI/Vercel, and proof links are reviewer-accessible.

options.title: Accept private-dependency risk
options.body: A maintainer can choose to merge with private package access as an intentional deployment policy, but they would own CI/deploy credential wiring before production release.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: If the design-system package should not be a ClawHub runtime dependency yet, pause or close this PR and continue with the narrower install/audit stack first.

recommendation.title: Wait for stack and credentials
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open and merge it only after the base PR lands or is merged in order, the design-system dependency is accessible to CI/Vercel, and proof links are reviewer-accessible.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick owns the current PR, the declared base stack, and recent current-main UI/token history for the affected surfaces.
